A genius strategist known as the Battlefield Trickster
Leader of the Ironrain Fireteam Fox and a strategist known as the Battlefield Trickster. Her easygoing and optimistic personality makes her seem careless, but her ability to find and exploit the enemy's weakness with pinpoint accuracy is truly remarkable. She holds an exalted belief that nothing is more precious than human life.
